title: 雅思核心词汇
description: 覆盖雅思阅读、写作和口语高频学术词汇。

englishDefinitions: to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen

exampleSentences.en: Our flight was cancelled.
exampleSentences.cn: 我们的航班取消了。

exampleSentences.en: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
exampleSentences.cn: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

exampleSentences.en: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
exampleSentences.cn: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “cancel”.

englishDefinitions: able or likely to explode
a substance that can cause an explosion

exampleSentences.cn: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，因此需要保存在高压容器内。

collocations.cn: 易爆气，爆炸气；爆炸性气体

words.sceneCue: IELTS · 爆炸的， 爆发的

englishDefinitions: to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future

exampleSentences.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “prepare”.

englishDefinitions: a doctor who does operations in a hospital

整形外科医生；骨科医师

englishDefinitions: the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms

exampleSentences.en: a huge tiled entrance hall

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “hall”.

englishDefinitions: A target vocabulary item commonly tested as “事先影响某人”.

englishDefinitions: to be in charge of a group of workers and check that a piece of work is done satisfactorily

englishDefinitions: the process of making air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use, or the state of being dangerously dirty

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “pollution”.

englishDefinitions: to behave as if something is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun

exampleSentences.en: Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
exampleSentences.cn: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

exampleSentences.cn: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

englishDefinitions: the movement in a gas or liquid caused by warm gas or liquid rising, and cold gas or liquid sinking

exampleSentences.en: ...clouds which lift warm, moist air by convection high into the atmosphere.
exampleSentences.cn: ...云层通过对流把温暖湿润的空气送到高的大气层中。

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “convection”.

englishDefinitions: to promise that something is true

exampleSentences.en: Therefore, it is important to note that individual situations may warrant including additional characters in the list of special characters.
exampleSentences.cn: 因此，要注意可能保证把额外字符包括到特殊字符列表中的个别情况，这一点很重要。

exampleSentences.en: Learning incessantly is the surest way to keep pace with the times in the information age and an infallible warrant of success in times of uncertainty.
exampleSentences.cn: 持续的学习是在资讯时代中跟时代并驾齐驱的最稳当的方法，也是在变动的世代中成功的可靠保证。

exampleSentences.en: At Dean Miller's suggestion, I have allowed her to give the current student organizers the opportunity to propose a program for next semester that might warrant continuation of this event on campus.
exampleSentences.cn: 根据米勒学监的建议，我允许她给学生机会，让他们给下学期的活动提出一个方案，保证这个活动得以在校园内继续开展。

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “warrant”.

englishDefinitions: the path along which the Sun seems to move

exampleSentences.en: On the astrolabe, an off - centered circle represents the orbit of the sun - the ecliptic.
exampleSentences.cn: 在星盘上， 一个偏心的圆代表了太阳的运行轨道――黄道。

exampleSentences.en: Recall that vernal equinox is one of the two intersection points of the celestial equator and the ecliptic.
exampleSentences.cn: 赤经计算的起点为春分点，相信你仍记得春分点是天球赤道和黄道的其中一个相交点。

exampleSentences.en: Because the Moon and bright planets wander through the sky near the ecliptic plane, such occultation events are not uncommon, but they are dramatic, especially in telescopic views.
exampleSentences.cn: 因为月球和明亮的行星出现在天空中黄道平面附近，这种掩星事件也很平常，但是它们也很富有戏剧性，特别是在望远镜影像里。

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “ecliptic”.

englishDefinitions: to hide something carefully

exampleSentences.en: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
exampleSentences.cn: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

exampleSentences.cn: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

exampleSentences.en: a concealed weapon
exampleSentences.cn: 藏匿的武器

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “conceal”.

words.rootAffix: Use the scene and example sentence to remember “meanwhile”.

definitions: 豪华的， 华丽的， 富裕的

englishDefinitions: having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard

englishDefinitions: to need something

englishDefinitions: a small cut on someone’s skin
